fields.description: Used to build the Payment Gateway name as 'Payrexx-{gateway_name}'. e.g. 'Live' or 'Sandbox'.
fields.label: Gateway Name

fields.description: Your Payrexx instance subdomain. For customer.pay.goodvantage.ch, use customer here and pay.goodvantage.ch in API Base Domain.
fields.label: Instance Name

fields.description: API base domain for Payrexx platform accounts. Use payrexx.com for normal Payrexx instances, or e.g. pay.goodvantage.ch for customer.pay.goodvantage.ch.
fields.label: API Base Domain

fields.description: API secret from Payrexx → Integrations → API & Plugins. Sent as the 'x-api-key' header.
fields.label: API Secret

fields.description: Signing key configured for the webhook in Payrexx → Webhooks. Used to verify the X-Webhook-Signature header.
fields.label: Webhook Signing Key

fields.description: Comma-separated ISO 4217 currency codes accepted by this gateway.
fields.label: Supported Currencies

fields.description: Optional: comma-separated list of Payrexx PSP IDs to restrict available payment providers (e.g. '4,17').
fields.label: PSP Whitelist

fields.description: How long the generated checkout link stays valid (in minutes). Leave blank for the Payrexx default.
fields.label: Gateway Validity (minutes)

fields.description: Optional override. By default the customer returns through server-side Payrexx reconciliation and is then sent to the payment success page.
fields.label: Success Redirect URL
